corrections.before: A blank known-time field must not submit as midnight
corrections.after: A blank known-time field must stay at native required-field validation

first_before_noise: Six waitForFunction errors were caused by the harness dereferencing the temporarily renamed busy button. Existing join success alerts and three isolated session keys were also initially miscounted.

revised_time_candidate.observed: Create empty known-hour/minute is rejected by the existing strict integer parser; submit focus stays outside the missing input, whose native valueMissing is false. Join empty-time fields are also native-valid and sent to the API (fictional intercepted acceptance only).
revised_time_candidate.rejected_hypothesis: Blank strings are not parsed as midnight. Existing integer() explicitly rejects them.
revised_time_candidate.minimal_authorized_improvement: Mark the four known-time inputs across create/manual-join forms required, so native validation focuses the missing field before submission; preserve existing parser, server, valid-known and unknown-time behavior.

limits: Only helper assumptions were corrected; UI assertions, original FAIL evidence and fixed fictional API protocol are retained. Fresh unchanged-product before-v2 establishes the valid baseline.
